**Fig. 1** Study design. Ten detectors were developed on the University of Washington Humphrey Visual Field (UWHVF) training and validation sets and evaluated four ways using only the first 3–6 tests of each series: E1, sensitivity and specificity against a reference based on each eye's full follow-up (UWHVF test set); E2, false alarms on true no-change series (Artes 12-week retest data, {{d:artes.n_patients}} patients); E3, a shuffle audit in which each test-set eye's tests are randomly re-ordered; and E4, detection of clinician-labelled progression in an external clinic (GRAPE, {{d:grape.n_eyes}} eyes). ML, machine learning

**Fig. 2** Sensitivity for future-confirmed progressors (UWHVF test set) against the false-alarm rate on true no-change data (Artes retest), for 3, 4, 5 and 6 tests. Bars show 95% confidence intervals (patient-cluster bootstrap). The shaded area marks false-alarm rates at or below the nominal 5% (dashed line). Detectors to the right of the shaded area gain sensitivity by raising false alarms. D1, OLS trend of mean sensitivity; D2, rate rule; D3, pointwise rule; D4, PoPLR; D5, pooled-shuffle conformal; D6, pooled-detrended conformal; D7, event analysis; D8, gradient-boosted trees; D9, recurrent network; D10, self-supervised order network

**Fig. 3** Shuffle audit against true no-change false alarms. Each point is one detector at one number of tests (3–6). The x-axis shows the share of UWHVF test-set series flagged after random re-ordering of the eye's own tests; the y-axis shows the false-alarm rate on true no-change series. The dashed line marks equality. Spearman ρ = {{s:spearman_rho}}; median absolute difference {{s:median_abs_diff}} percentage points. Rules without a p-value (rate rule, event analysis) lie below the line

**Fig. 4** External clinic (GRAPE). Sensitivity for clinician-labelled progression (mean-deviation criterion) against 1 − specificity, using the first three (left) or four (right) tests. Bars show 95% confidence intervals. D5 and D7 were re-calibrated on GRAPE by patient-level cross-fitting; D8 was transferred unchanged from UWHVF; D6, D9 and D10 were not applied (24-2 grid only). Abbreviations as in Fig. 2
